ns2:course.label: Contemp Issues in Inst Mus Ed
ns2:course.description: Research-based investigation of concepts and principles of school band programs including repertoire and curriculum, score study and teaching strategies, and leadership and advocacy. Prerequisite: Completion of student teaching, graduate standing in music education, or consent of instructor.
